title: build_credential_store erases CredentialStoreError to String — loses structured error
description: server_stores.rs build_credential_store() returns Result<CredentialStore, String>, discarding the typed CredentialStoreError via .map_err(|e| e.to_string()). The ServerStores::new_with_ipfs return type is also String. This means config-loading errors lose their variant information, making programmatic error handling impossible. Not a correctness problem today (errors go to stderr), but an obstacle to future structured error reporting or telemetry.
